name: Suika3
blurb: Suika3 is a high-performance, mobile-first 2D game engine designed for visual novels.
description:
Suika3 is a high-performance, mobile-first 2D game engine designed for
visual novels. It focuses on portability, written in C89 to ensure
long-term maintenance and compatibility.

• Target: Mobile-first, yet runs anywhere including Linux

• High-Performance: Native, written in C

• Hybrid Scripting: JIT VM with AOT fallback for App Store compliance

• Broad Platforms: Desktop, mobile, and game consoles

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
